values.note: 50 campsites: 44 drive-up plus six walk-in tent sites (P12-P17) on the high bank of Lake Superior, ~50 yards from the parking area. The booking site allows a trailer or RV up to 45 ft at P20, P32 and P49, 35 ft at 12 sites, 30 ft at P18 and 25 ft at 5 more (P1, P3, P9, P21, P28); the other 23 drive-up sites stop at 20 ft. No pull-throughs.

note: Rustic campground at the west end of Porcupine Mountains Wilderness State Park, near the Presque Isle River's waterfalls and the Lake Superior shore, reached by County Road 519 from Wakefield; separate from Union Bay. Two loops: the east loop allows generators, the west loop is generator-free. Trail access to the Presque Isle River and the Lake Superior shoreline. County Road 519 stays open when M-107 and South Boundary Road close for winter. --Claude

No operating-season statement, so season stays absent. No closure notice; the park's winter road closures exclude CR 519. Pin matches OSM's 'Presque Isle Rustic Campground'.
